_readme: Company-announced report dates that beat Finnhub's projection (ticket 0013). Company releases only; every entry needs an https source and a checked date within 30 days (npm test enforces it). quarter/year are Finnhub's labels for that report. hour is the company's stated session (bmo, amc, dmh); leave it out when the release names none (never copy an aggregator's time). Entries stop applying 14 days after their date; delete them then.

ARM.note: Arm, Oct 5: Wed Nov 4 after market close, call 5:00 pm ET. Finnhub: Nov 5, time unknown.

AXON.note: Axon, Oct 22: Thu Nov 5 after the close. Finnhub: Nov 2 projection, then no Q3 row at all.

FIS.note: FIS, Oct 20: new date Nov 4. Finnhub: Nov 3.

APD.note: Air Products, Oct 6: call Nov 5, 8:00 am ET. Finnhub: Nov 4 after the close.

STE.note: STERIS: release after the close Nov 4, call Nov 5 9 am. Finnhub used the call date (Nov 5).

WES.note: Western Midstream, Oct 19: results after market close Wed Nov 4, call Thu Nov 5 10 am ET. Nasdaq agrees. Finnhub: Nov 2, then Feb 16 on the sheet.

PAA.note: Plains, Oct 1 (GlobeNewswire, per the critic's 2026-11-04 read): Q3 before the open Fri Nov 6, call 10 am ET. The release answers 403 from the builder sandbox, so on 2026-11-04 the date and session were confirmed on Nasdaq's per-day calendar (pre-market Nov 6). Finnhub: Nov 3 blank session, then Feb 4 on the sheet.

CSCO.note: Cisco, Nov 3 (PR Newswire): Q1 FY27 results after the close Thu Nov 12, call 4:30 pm ET. investor.cisco.com answers 403 from the builder sandbox, so on 2026-11-05 the release was read on Finviz's wire copy (finviz.com/news/414708). Finnhub: Nov 18, then Nov 12 with a blank session. Nasdaq: Nov 11 (wrong).

HMC.note: Honda IR page (read 2026-11-05): FY Q2 results Tue Nov 10 at 15:35 JST (01:35 ET), before the US open. Finnhub: Nov 5, time unknown. Nasdaq: Nov 6 (wrong).

TSN.note: Tyson, Sep 24 (GlobeNewswire): Q4 results before the open Mon Nov 16, call 9:00 am ET. Nasdaq agrees (pre-market). Finnhub: Nov 16 after the close.

BN.note: Brookfield Corporation, Oct 9 (GlobeNewswire 2026/10/09/3378387, which answers 403 from the builder sandbox; read on Finviz's wire copy): Q3 2026 results about 7:00 am ET Thu Nov 12, call 10:00 am ET. Nasdaq agrees (Nov 12, pre-market). Finnhub: Tue Nov 10, time unknown. Not Brookfield Business Corp (BBUC, Nov 5).

HSAI.note: Hesai, Oct 20 (GlobeNewswire wire copy): Q3 2026 results Tue Nov 10 before the US open, call 7:00 am ET. Nasdaq agrees (Nov 10, pre-market). Finnhub: Mon Nov 9, time unknown.

ROST.note: Ross Stores, Nov 5 (wire copy on Finviz): Q3 2026 results Thu Nov 19 at about 4:00 pm ET, call 4:15 pm ET. Nasdaq agrees (Nov 19, after hours). Finnhub: Wed Nov 18, time unknown. Finnhub labels this fiscal-2026 quarter Q3 2027.

PANW.note: Palo Alto Networks, Nov 3 (PR Newswire release 302927448, read on stockhub.kr's wire copy): fiscal Q1 2027 results after US markets close Wed Nov 18, webcast 4:30 pm ET. Nasdaq agrees (after hours). Finnhub: Nov 18, time unknown.

BABA.note: Alibaba 6-K, Nov 6 (Ex. 99.1, HKEX board-meeting notice): board meets Nov 18, results announced Thu Nov 19, 2026. The notice gives the day only; the session is Nasdaq's day calendar (pre-market, read 2026-11-10) and last year's September-quarter release, which also came before the US open. Finnhub: Dec 1 on the sheet, Nov 19 or Nov 23 on the calendar, time unknown.

GAP.note: Gap Inc., Oct 29 (PR Newswire 302924200): Q3 fiscal 2026 results Thu Nov 19 at about 1:15 pm PT, call 2:00 pm PT, after the close. Nasdaq agrees (after hours). Finnhub: Wed Nov 18, time unknown. Finnhub labels this fiscal-2026 quarter Q3 2027.

QXO.note: QXO, Inc. Form 8-K exhibit of Nov 9 (preliminary Q3 2026 results): 'The Company expects to report its full third quarter 2026 results on November 12, 2026.' No session given, so none is set (aggregators' 'after the close' is not a company fact). Nasdaq agrees (Nov 12). Finnhub: Tue Nov 17, time unknown.

ADI.note: Analog Devices, Oct 22: 'will release financial results for the fourth quarter fiscal year 2026 at 7:00 a.m. Eastern time on Tuesday, November 24, 2026', call 10:00 a.m. ET (read through the search index; the page answers 503 to the sandbox). Webull/Barchart (news 15837304224652288): before the market opens on Tuesday, Nov. 24. Nasdaq agrees (pre-market). Finnhub: Nov 24 after the close (0060).

ROAD.note: Construction Partners, Nov 5 (preliminary fiscal 2026 results; wire copy of PR Newswire 302930312): 'conference call on Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time' for the quarter and year ended Sep 30. The release doesn't say when results come out, so no session is set (a call time alone isn't a session). Finnhub: Nov 19 after the close, later before the open; Nasdaq: pre-market (0062).

MRVL.note: Marvell, Nov 6 (Business Wire 20261106322575, which doesn't answer the builder sandbox; read on 2026-11-13 on Yahoo Finance's wire copy, the source here): 'a conference call following the release of its third quarter of fiscal year 2027 financial results on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time.' The release gives the call time only, so no session is set; a 1:30 pm PT call strongly suggests results after the close. Finnhub: Thu Nov 26 (Thanksgiving), time unknown (0063).

DLTR.note: Dollar Tree 8-K, Nov 3 (Ex. 99.1, read 2026-11-13): will report results for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 ended Oct 31 'before the stock market opens on Tuesday, November 24, 2026', call 8 a.m. ET. Nasdaq agrees (Nov 24, pre-market). Finnhub: Tue Dec 1, time unknown (0068). Finnhub labels this fiscal-2026 quarter Q3 2027.

ANF.note: Abercrombie & Fitch Co., Oct 30 (GlobeNewswire; wire copy read 2026-11-13 ET): third quarter 2026 results press release 'expected to be issued shortly after 7:30 a.m. ET', call 'on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET'. 7:30 a.m. is before the open, so bmo is stated, not inferred. Nasdaq agrees (Nov 24, pre-market). Finnhub: Mon Nov 23, time unknown, labelled Q3 2027 (0069).

DKS.note: Dick's Sporting Goods, Nov 2 (PR Newswire; wire copy read 2026-11-13 ET): 'will announce results for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 before the market opens on Tuesday, November 24th', call 8:00 a.m. ET. Nasdaq agrees (Nov 24, pre-market). Finnhub: Mon Nov 23, time unknown, labelled Q3 2027 (0069).

BURL.note: Burlington Stores, Nov 10 (GlobeNewswire; wire copy read 2026-11-13 ET): 'will release its third quarter fiscal year 2026 results before the U.S. stock market opens on Tuesday, November 24, 2026', call 8:30 a.m. ET. Nasdaq agrees (Nov 24, pre-market). Finnhub: Mon Nov 23, time unknown, labelled Q3 2027 (0069).

WMT.note: Walmart's event page (read 2026-11-14): FY2027 Q3 earnings release Nov. 19, 2026, 'quarterly earnings materials will be available at approximately 6 a.m. CT on the date of release', call 7:00 a.m. CT. 6 a.m. CT is before the open, so bmo is stated. Nasdaq agrees (pre-market). Finnhub: Nov 19, time often blank, labelled Q3 2027 (0050).

TGT.note: Target's investor events page (read 2026-11-14): Q3 2026 earnings conference call Wednesday, November 18, 2026, 8:00 - 9:00 a.m. ET. A call that ends before the 9:30 open means the results come out before it, so bmo follows from the company's own schedule (as APD). Nasdaq agrees (pre-market). Finnhub: Nov 18, time often blank, labelled Q3 2027 (0050).
